title: CEO Obvi (team 8 người, doanh số ~$30M) mới share tech stack.
subtitle: Còn của công ty mình cho 4-5 stores thì dùng tech stacks sau:
body:
[

![](/writing/ceo-obvi-team-8-nguoi-doanh-so-30m/59372b33-109d-460e-8d76-224f1912a57e.webp)

](/writing/ceo-obvi-team-8-nguoi-doanh-so-30m/59372b33-109d-460e-8d76-224f1912a57e.webp)
Còn của công ty mình cho 4-5 stores thì dùng tech stacks sau:

Back-End

- CMS: Shopify + Funnelish

- P&L: Lark + TrueProfit by [Hoang Chu](https://www.facebook.com/omegakeke?__cft__[0]=AZWHnsiUu_Sl-pENFx2cb0kpr1QyLuj5YglP-zRanFLXhgyrnSYbL-KeV2uCP-JJameFPkKghqeWBICpVVKRMCTwCpqBPiYKlDN2qpgMmLTW-Kcu1oJmfHZ0Sex5CSTZhqtIR36R9Wez20oOZYRpd6Zv&__tn__=-]K-R)

- Credit Card: Wise + Mercury + Payoneer + Pingpong

- Customer Support: Reamaze

- Google Shopping Feeding App: Simprosys Google Shopping Feed

- Fulfill: Bulk Fulfill & Paypal Tracking

Email, SMS, Retention

- Popup Optin: OptiMonk

- Email + SMS: Klaviyo

- Retention: Rebuy (most powerful cart + post purchase app)

- Landing Page Builder: GemPages (credit to [Chris Koh](https://www.facebook.com/chris.ecommerce?__cft__[0]=AZWHnsiUu_Sl-pENFx2cb0kpr1QyLuj5YglP-zRanFLXhgyrnSYbL-KeV2uCP-JJameFPkKghqeWBICpVVKRMCTwCpqBPiYKlDN2qpgMmLTW-Kcu1oJmfHZ0Sex5CSTZhqtIR36R9Wez20oOZYRpd6Zv&__tn__=-]K-R) team)

Auto Display Ads: Ads Roll

- Update Tracking: TrackingMore - Order Tracking

Everything Design, Creative & Branding [Hoang M. Phuc](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100009626626644&__cft__[0]=AZWHnsiUu_Sl-pENFx2cb0kpr1QyLuj5YglP-zRanFLXhgyrnSYbL-KeV2uCP-JJameFPkKghqeWBICpVVKRMCTwCpqBPiYKlDN2qpgMmLTW-Kcu1oJmfHZ0Sex5CSTZhqtIR36R9Wez20oOZYRpd6Zv&__tn__=-]K-R) + AI stacks (ChatGPT, 11Lab, Descript, Text2Speech...)

Cùng hàng loạt các app social media free khác (TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, ShopPay, etc)

Một số app có link affiliate deal ngon ở dưới comment

Anh em đang dùng tech stack nào comment bên dưới xem :-?
